Shrouded in Mist#004.src: Would you like to challenge Sovereign Zhiraok again?
Shrouded in Mist#004.dst: Quer desafiar o Soberano Zhiraok de novo?

Shrouded in Mist#005.src: New Chapter Started: Amongst the Canopy
Shrouded in Mist#005.dst: Novo capítulo iniciado: Em meio ao Dossel

Shrouded in Mist#006.src: There's a thin layer of dust on top of the bed.
Shrouded in Mist#006.dst: Há uma fina camada de poeira sobre a cama.

Shrouded in Mist#007.src: The monitor is keeping the machine running.
Shrouded in Mist#007.dst: O monitor mantém a máquina funcionando.

Shrouded in Mist#008.src: Maybe something sharp can break it...

Shrouded in Mist#009.src: - Entry {~}: Stayed in and slept all day. Was very tired.
Shrouded in Mist#009.dst: - Nota {~}: Dormi o dia todo em casa. Estava exausto.

Shrouded in Mist#010.src: - Entry {~}: Slept in. Boss wasn't happy with me, has me working extra shifts next week.
Shrouded in Mist#010.dst: - Nota {~}: Perdi a hora. O chefe não gostou, me pôs em turnos extras semana que vem.

Shrouded in Mist#013.src: The entries stop after this point...

Shrouded in Mist#014.src: This must be where Nisen lives...
Shrouded in Mist#014.dst: Deve ser aqui que o Nisen mora...

Shrouded in Mist#015.src: Group up with the remaining members at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#015.dst: Reúna-se com os membros restantes em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#019.src: About what? What could you possibly be thinking about right-
Shrouded in Mist#019.dst: Em quê? No que você poderia estar pensando bem ag-
Shrouded in Mist#019.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#020.src: I don't know, Yusanu! Maybe about what to do next? How we can- h-how we-
Shrouded in Mist#020.dst: Não sei, Yusanu! Talvez no que fazer agora? Como podemos- c-como-
Shrouded in Mist#020.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#021.src: There's nothing we can do! We're stuck in unfamiliar territory, all alone, our family and friends all captured, or- or worse-
Shrouded in Mist#021.dst: Não há nada a fazer! Estamos presos em território desconhecido, sozinhos, com família e amigos capturados, ou- ou pior-
Shrouded in Mist#021.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#023.src: Urgh! I can't believe I let her convince me stealing this... this thing was worth it! If I hadn't, then... then our agreement wouldn't have fallen through, and none of this would have-
Shrouded in Mist#023.dst: Argh! Não acredito que deixei ela me convencer de que roubar esta... esta coisa valia a pena! Se não fosse isso... nosso acordo não teria furado, e nada disso teria-
Shrouded in Mist#023.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#024.src: Don't you dare pin this on Rex. You heard what that Sovereign said, they- th-they knew what we were planning for ages!
Shrouded in Mist#024.dst: Não ouse pôr a culpa na Rex. Você ouviu o que aquele Soberano disse, eles- e-eles sabiam do nosso plano há séculos!
Shrouded in Mist#024.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#025.src: ...then maybe it'd have been best if you left us out of it.
Shrouded in Mist#025.dst: ...então era melhor ter deixado a gente fora disso.
Shrouded in Mist#025.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#029.src: Woah woah woah woah woah! Alright, let's all take a step back, shall we?
Shrouded in Mist#029.dst: Opa opa opa opa opa! Certo, vamos todos dar um passo atrás, que tal?

Shrouded in Mist#030.src: Owls! Step down! Bit of a leap, jumping straight to violence- we reserve that for the obviously crown-aligned, eheheh.
Shrouded in Mist#030.dst: Corujas! Recuar! Partir direto pra violência é exagero- isso fica pros óbvios aliados da Coroa, eheheh.

Shrouded in Mist#031.src: Allow me to introduce myself! The name's Rurie, member of the Canopy, captain of the Owls division! Apologies for the roughhousing, seems everyone's a little enthusiastic today, eh?
Shrouded in Mist#031.dst: Permitam que eu me apresente! Meu nome é Rurie, membro do Dosel, capitão da divisão das Corujas! Desculpem a brutalidade, parece que hoje todos estão meio empolgados, hein?
Shrouded in Mist#031.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#033.src: Questions, questions! I'm afraid it's our turn first- I've called the owls off for a time, but don't think you're off the hook just yet, young lady!
Shrouded in Mist#033.dst: Perguntas, perguntas! Receio que a vez seja nossa primeiro- chamei as corujas de volta por ora, mas não pense que já se livrou, mocinha!
Shrouded in Mist#033.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#034.src: ...captain, are you certain about this? For all we know, they could be spies-
Shrouded in Mist#034.dst: ...capitão, tem certeza disso? Pelo que sabemos, podem ser espiões-
Shrouded in Mist#034.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#035.src: Ah ah ah! Trust in the process, my friend. Spies or not, information is valuable.
Shrouded in Mist#035.dst: Ah ah ah! Confie no processo, meu amigo. Espiões ou não, informação vale ouro.
Shrouded in Mist#035.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#036.src: Besides! We know how to... ah, deal with spies, as it were. Risk factor is minimal!
Shrouded in Mist#036.dst: Além disso! Sabemos... ah, lidar com espiões, por assim dizer. O risco é mínimo!
Shrouded in Mist#036.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#037.src: So... what, are you also resisting-
Shrouded in Mist#037.dst: Então... o quê, vocês também resistem-
Shrouded in Mist#037.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#038.src: Hold it there, mister! Didn't you hear me? We'll be asking the questions here first.
Shrouded in Mist#038.dst: Alto lá, moço! Não me ouviu? Quem faz as perguntas aqui primeiro somos nós.
Shrouded in Mist#038.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#039.src: Seems you're the only one who hasn't spoken yet! Well now, don't be shy. Tell me - where are you lot from?
Shrouded in Mist#039.dst: Parece que você é o único que ainda não falou! Ora, não seja tímido. Diga - de onde vocês são?
Shrouded in Mist#039.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#040.src: Really? Quite far afield, aren't you? Finding your way from there to here is quite an endeavor.
Shrouded in Mist#040.dst: Sério? Bem longe daqui, hein? Achar o caminho de lá até aqui é uma façanha e tanto.
Shrouded in Mist#040.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#041.src: Ahhh! Now the pieces are clicking together! I think I get it now.
Shrouded in Mist#041.dst: Ahhh! Agora as peças se encaixam! Acho que entendi.
Shrouded in Mist#041.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#042.src: Ohoho? Really now? How very, very curious. You're either a verrrry clever spy, or...
Shrouded in Mist#042.dst: Ohoho? Sério? Que curioso, muito curioso. Ou você é um espião muuuito esperto, ou...
Shrouded in Mist#042.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#043.src: H... hey! Listen! I don't know who, or, or what you guys are, but--
Shrouded in Mist#043.dst: E... ei! Escutem! Não sei quem, ou, ou o que vocês são, mas--
Shrouded in Mist#043.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#044.src: How many times must I repeat myself? I said no que-
Shrouded in Mist#044.dst: Quantas vezes preciso repetir? Eu disse nada de pergun-
Shrouded in Mist#044.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#045.src: Shut UP! We just BARELY escaped {p} after we- after we tried to KILL the Queen! The rest of our friends are... captured, or d- dead!
Shrouded in Mist#045.dst: CALA A BOCA! A gente MAL fugiu de {p} depois de- depois de tentar MATAR a Rainha! O resto dos amigos está... preso, ou m- morto!
Shrouded in Mist#045.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#046.src: So- so either leave us alone, or I'll- I'll make sure you never see your loved ones a- again!
Shrouded in Mist#046.dst: Então- ou nos deixam em paz, ou eu- eu garanto que nunca mais verão quem amam d- de novo!
Shrouded in Mist#046.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#049.src: Ohoho, she's sure got some temper, huh?
Shrouded in Mist#049.dst: Ohoho, ela tem um gênio e tanto, hein?
Shrouded in Mist#049.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#050.src: Rurie... her story could explain what-
Shrouded in Mist#050.dst: Rurie... a história dela explicaria o que-
Shrouded in Mist#050.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#051.src: Yes, my friend, I was just thinking the very same thing. Well well, new folk, if what you're saying is true, the Canopy might just be able to assist!
Shrouded in Mist#051.dst: Sim, meu amigo, eu pensava exatamente o mesmo. Ora, ora, recém-chegados, se o que dizem é verdade, talvez o Dosel possa ajudar!
Shrouded in Mist#051.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#052.src: I may have information regarding your allies.
Shrouded in Mist#052.dst: Talvez eu tenha informações sobre seus aliados.
Shrouded in Mist#052.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#054.src: Ah- but! But but but, see - trust is a currency here in the {p}. I can't just spill all my secrets at once, can I?
Shrouded in Mist#054.dst: Ah- mas! Mas mas mas, vejam - confiança é moeda aqui em {p}. Não posso soltar todos os segredos de uma vez, né?
Shrouded in Mist#054.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#055.src: And if you'd like to earn our trust... I'll need you to, ah, deal with some things for me.
Shrouded in Mist#055.dst: E se quiserem nossa confiança... vou precisar que, ah, cuidem de umas coisas pra mim.
Shrouded in Mist#055.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#057.src: Oh, nothing too difficult... I'll tell you on one condition! I'll be taking one of you with me as leverage! Eenie, meenie, money... you, little man!
Shrouded in Mist#057.dst: Ah, nada muito difícil... Conto com uma condição! Vou levar um de vocês comigo como garantia! Uni, duni, tê... você, homenzinho!
Shrouded in Mist#057.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#059.src: You, indeed! Worry not, for I'll be sure to keep you safe, but... well, you understand the need, yes?
Shrouded in Mist#059.dst: Você mesmo! Não tema, vou garantir sua segurança, mas... bem, vocês entendem a necessidade, sim?
Shrouded in Mist#059.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#060.src: We can't! We can't lose... we can't lose anyone else. Please, there has to be something-
Shrouded in Mist#060.dst: Não! Não podemos perder... não podemos perder mais ninguém. Por favor, deve haver algo-
Shrouded in Mist#060.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#061.src: Sui... it's... fine. I don't think we have a choice. Just... do what they ask of you.
Shrouded in Mist#061.dst: Sui... tá... tudo bem. Acho que não temos escolha. Só... façam o que pedirem.
Shrouded in Mist#061.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#062.src: Goodness, so melodramatic! Come on, I'm a trustworthy fella! You've got nothing to worry about from me.
Shrouded in Mist#062.dst: Nossa, que melodrama! Ora, sou um sujeito de confiança! Vocês não têm nada a temer de mim.
Shrouded in Mist#062.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#064.src: Ah-mazing! I'm glad you chose to be reasonable. In that case - I'll need the remaining two of you to go and sabotage three military structures.
Shrouded in Mist#064.dst: Ma-ravilha! Fico feliz que tenham sido razoáveis. Nesse caso - preciso que vocês dois que restam sabotem três estruturas militares.
Shrouded in Mist#064.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#065.src: Now, go and say your goodbyes, then come grab the list from me!
Shrouded in Mist#065.dst: Agora vão se despedir, e depois venham pegar a lista comigo!
Shrouded in Mist#065.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#066.src: Talk to Rurie before heading out at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#066.dst: Fale com Rurie antes de partir, em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#067.src: Hey. You'll be fine. I'll be fine.
Shrouded in Mist#067.dst: Ei. Você vai ficar bem. Eu também.
Shrouded in Mist#067.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#068.src: I think we can trust them for now, at least. Not like we have an alternative...
Shrouded in Mist#068.dst: Acho que podemos confiar neles por ora, pelo menos. Nem temos outra opção...
Shrouded in Mist#068.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#069.src: We really... don't have a choice, do we? We, we need their support.
Shrouded in Mist#069.dst: Não temos... escolha, né? Nós, nós precisamos da ajuda deles.
Shrouded in Mist#069.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#070.src: I just... hope Yusanu will be safe.
Shrouded in Mist#070.dst: Só... espero que o Yusanu fique bem.
Shrouded in Mist#070.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#071.src: Ugh... Captain's being reckless as usual...
Shrouded in Mist#071.dst: Argh... o capitão, imprudente como sempre...
Shrouded in Mist#071.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#072.src: Have we finished with the heartfelt goodbyes? Excellent. Truly, I am glad you took me up on this generous offer.
Shrouded in Mist#072.dst: Terminamos as despedidas emotivas? Excelente. Fico feliz mesmo que aceitaram minha generosa oferta.
Shrouded in Mist#072.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#073.src: Don't worry about your little friend over there! He'll be safe and sound amongst our Canopy.
Shrouded in Mist#073.dst: Não se preocupem com o amiguinho de vocês! Ele vai ficar são e salvo aqui no nosso Dosel.
Shrouded in Mist#073.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#074.src: ...and how can we trust you? To not... hurt him?
Shrouded in Mist#074.dst: ...e como confiar em você? Que não vai... feri-lo?
Shrouded in Mist#074.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#075.src: Ah, isn't that the issue at the heart of it all? You can't. But as I said, trust is valuable in these woods. That must go both ways!
Shrouded in Mist#075.dst: Ah, não é essa a questão central? Não podem. Mas, como eu disse, confiança vale muito nesta floresta. E vale pros dois lados!
Shrouded in Mist#075.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#076.src: Well, newbies! You've a list of the structures I need you to sabotage, so it really should be a simple task.
Shrouded in Mist#076.dst: Bem, novatos! Vocês têm a lista das estruturas que quero sabotadas, então deve ser uma tarefa simples.
Shrouded in Mist#076.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#077.src: Just find a way to... disable them! However you manage it, I can't say I really care - so long as it gets done!
Shrouded in Mist#077.dst: É só achar um jeito de... desativá-las! Como vão fazer, sinceramente não me importa - contanto que seja feito!
Shrouded in Mist#077.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#078.src: Why are you getting us to do
Shrouded in Mist#078.dst: Por que a gente tem que fazer

Shrouded in Mist#080.src: Why, because it's a golden opportunity! The work needs doing, and you need a way to prove yourselves...
Shrouded in Mist#080.dst: Ora, porque é uma oportunidade de ouro! O trabalho precisa ser feito, e vocês, provar seu valor...
Shrouded in Mist#080.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#081.src: So why not? It's less work for me to do, so I'm not complaining!
Shrouded in Mist#081.dst: E por que não? É menos trabalho pra mim, então nem reclamo!
Shrouded in Mist#081.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#082.src: Newbies! That's what you are, isn't it? New to the woods, new to the world...
Shrouded in Mist#082.dst: Novatos! É isso que vocês são, não é? Novos na floresta, novos no mundo...
Shrouded in Mist#082.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#083.src: ...maybe new to Fruma, even? Ah ah, wipe that expression of shock off your face! I won't tell if you don't either.
Shrouded in Mist#083.dst: ...talvez novos em Fruma, até? Ah ah, tire essa cara de espanto! Eu não conto se você também não contar.
Shrouded in Mist#083.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#085.src: Once you're done, find me back here! Just don't take too long, eh? Wouldn't want to get bored!
Shrouded in Mist#085.dst: Quando terminarem, me encontrem aqui! Só não demorem muito, hein? Não quero ficar entediado!
Shrouded in Mist#085.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#086.src: Ta ta, newbies! Good luck out there! And just a word of advice - stay on your guard. You never know what the mists may be hiding.
Shrouded in Mist#086.dst: Tchauzinho, novatos! Boa sorte por aí! E só um conselho - fiquem atentos. Nunca se sabe o que a névoa pode esconder.
Shrouded in Mist#086.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#087.src: Select the structure to sabotage using the checklist.
Shrouded in Mist#087.dst: Escolha a estrutura a sabotar usando a lista.

Shrouded in Mist#088.src: Still a bit lost? Just use your taskbook to find the things I need broken!
Shrouded in Mist#088.dst: Ainda perdidos? Usem o livro de missões pra achar o que quero quebrado!
Shrouded in Mist#088.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#089.src: Head to the watchtower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and sabotage it using a spell.
Shrouded in Mist#089.dst: Vá até a torre de vigia em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] e sabote-a usando um feitiço.

Shrouded in Mist#090.src: So is this... the place? "Military... Watchtower..." I guess so.
Shrouded in Mist#090.dst: Este é... o lugar? "Torre de vigia... militar..." Acho que sim.
Shrouded in Mist#090.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#091.src: Those supports look rather unstable, don't they? I wonder...
Shrouded in Mist#091.dst: Esses suportes parecem bem instáveis, não? Fico pensando...
Shrouded in Mist#091.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#092.src: C-can you deal with them, please?
Shrouded in Mist#092.dst: V-você pode cuidar deles, por favor?
Shrouded in Mist#092.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#093.src: Huh?! We're under attack - it must be the Canopy!
Shrouded in Mist#093.dst: Hein?! Estamos sob ataque - deve ser o Dosel!
Shrouded in Mist#093.speaker: Watchtower Guard

Shrouded in Mist#095.src: Let's just get this over with.
Shrouded in Mist#095.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#096.src: Check the book, where should we go next?
Shrouded in Mist#096.dst: Olhe o livro, pra onde vamos agora?
Shrouded in Mist#096.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#098.src: Head to the water pump at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and sabotage it.
Shrouded in Mist#098.dst: Vá até a bomba d'água em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] e sabote-a.

Shrouded in Mist#100.src: I think we can work together for this one. Go, um, blast some weak spots on the structure, and I'll... see if I can reverse the water flow.
Shrouded in Mist#100.dst: Acho que nessa dá pra trabalhar junto. Vá, hã, explodir uns pontos fracos da estrutura, e eu... vejo se consigo inverter o fluxo da água.
Shrouded in Mist#100.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#101.src: Let's just... get rid of this hunk of junk.
Shrouded in Mist#101.dst: Vamos só... nos livrar desse monte de sucata.
Shrouded in Mist#101.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#102.src: You, um, should try to blast some of the weak points with your magic.
Shrouded in Mist#102.dst: Você, hã, devia tentar explodir alguns pontos fracos com sua magia.
Shrouded in Mist#102.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#103.src: Did you manage to apply some pressure on the pipes?
Shrouded in Mist#103.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#104.src: Good, then it's... time for my part, I guess. Um, come talk to me when you're ready.
Shrouded in Mist#104.dst: Ótimo, então é... minha vez, eu acho. Hã, venha falar comigo quando estiver pronto.
Shrouded in Mist#104.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#106.src: Okay... okay. Breathe. I need to... focus.
Shrouded in Mist#106.dst: Tá... tá. Respira. Preciso... me concentrar.
Shrouded in Mist#106.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#107.src: After... after, um, everything that- that's happened, I've been... struggling with my cur-... ugh. You get what I mean.
Shrouded in Mist#107.dst: Depois... depois de, hã, tudo que- que aconteceu, ando... com dificuldade com a minha maldi-... argh. Você entende.
Shrouded in Mist#107.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#108.src: It all feels so... so... hopeless! We've lost everyone, and now- now we've lost Yusanu too, and I... I couldn't do anything!
Shrouded in Mist#108.dst: Parece tudo tão... tão... sem esperança! Perdemos todos, e agora- agora o Yusanu também, e eu... não pude fazer nada!
Shrouded in Mist#108.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#109.src: And the last thing we did before was... argue! And now, he's... he's safe, probably, but... I don't know. I wish we hadn't.
Shrouded in Mist#109.dst: E a última coisa que fizemos foi... brigar! E agora ele está... seguro, talvez, mas... sei lá. Queria não ter brigado.
Shrouded in Mist#109.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#110.src: Every time I think about- about any of it, I get so... angry! And the swirling ocean around me starts raging more and more and more, and... and...
Shrouded in Mist#110.dst: Toda vez que penso em- em qualquer coisa disso, fico tão... furiosa! E o oceano que gira ao meu redor se agita mais e mais e mais, e... e...
Shrouded in Mist#110.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#111.src: I'm scared, {u}. I'm scared for Mora... Syndra... Rex, Zeph, the whole Steel Feather- for all of them! And I... there's nothing I can do...
Shrouded in Mist#111.dst: Tenho medo, {u}. Medo pelo Mora... Syndra... Rex, Zeph, toda a Pluma de Aço- por todos! E eu... não posso fazer nada...
Shrouded in Mist#111.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#112.src: What if... what if they're all gone? And, and, and it's just us, forever...?
Shrouded in Mist#112.dst: E se... e se todos tiverem morrido? E, e, e for só a gente, pra sempre...?
Shrouded in Mist#112.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#113.src: I... I know, {u}, I know! I'm... I'm trying, okay?!
Shrouded in Mist#113.dst: Eu... eu sei, {u}, eu sei! Eu... eu estou tentando, tá?!
Shrouded in Mist#113.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#115.src: I don't know if I, ha, have any left. Everything's... moving so fast...
Shrouded in Mist#115.dst: Não sei se eu, ha, ainda tenho forças. Tudo está... indo tão rápido...
Shrouded in Mist#115.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#116.src: I... I never wanted any of this. I just... I just wanted to live...
Shrouded in Mist#116.dst: Eu... eu nunca quis nada disso. Eu só... eu só queria viver...
Shrouded in Mist#116.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#117.src: Sigh... okay. Sui, focus. You can do this.
Shrouded in Mist#117.dst: Suspiro... tá. Sui, foco. Você consegue.
Shrouded in Mist#117.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#118.dst: Aaah! O- o que foi isso?!
Shrouded in Mist#118.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#119.src: That's... I don't... how did I...
Shrouded in Mist#119.dst: Isso é... eu não... como eu...
Shrouded in Mist#119.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#120.src: It... the ocean, it... stopped. I pulled at it, and it... it stopped moving, and...
Shrouded in Mist#120.dst: Ele... o oceano, ele... parou. Eu puxei, e ele... ele parou de se mexer, e...
Shrouded in Mist#120.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#121.src: There's... there's no time to, to think about it. It worked, so... so that's good.
Shrouded in Mist#121.dst: Não... não há tempo pra, pra pensar nisso. Funcionou, então... então é bom.
Shrouded in Mist#121.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#122.src: Just... check the book, what's our next stop?
Shrouded in Mist#122.dst: Só... olhe o livro, qual a próxima parada?
Shrouded in Mist#122.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#123.src: I... I think that was the last one. Let's go tell Rurie that it's, um, done.
Shrouded in Mist#123.dst: Eu... acho que essa era a última. Vamos avisar o Rurie que, hã, está feito.
Shrouded in Mist#123.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#124.src: Head to the mining drill at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#124.dst: Vá até a perfuratriz de mineração em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#125.dst: Essa é... com certeza a perfuratriz.
Shrouded in Mist#125.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#126.src: It looks... durable. Like, um, it'll be hard to just... break. We need to find another way...
Shrouded in Mist#126.dst: Parece... resistente. Tipo, hã, vai ser difícil só... quebrar. Temos que achar outro jeito...
Shrouded in Mist#126.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#127.src: There- there isn't any water nearby. So, so if any soldiers show up... please, can you deal with them?
Shrouded in Mist#127.dst: Não- não tem água por perto. Então, então se aparecer algum soldado... por favor, pode cuidar deles?
Shrouded in Mist#127.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#128.src: Aha, saboteurs! You won't get away with damaging the crown's property, not on my watch!
Shrouded in Mist#128.dst: Ahá, sabotadores! Danificar bens da Coroa e sair impunes? Não sob minha vigília!
Shrouded in Mist#128.speaker: Mistwoods Captain

Shrouded in Mist#129.src: Um... good job, {u}. I didn't think about breaking the controls...
Shrouded in Mist#129.dst: Hã... bom trabalho, {u}. Não pensei em quebrar os controles...
Shrouded in Mist#129.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#130.src: We should check the book, and find our next stop.
Shrouded in Mist#130.dst: Devíamos olhar o livro e achar nossa próxima parada.
Shrouded in Mist#130.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#131.src: Was that the last one? Let's head back to Rurie and... and tell him it's done.
Shrouded in Mist#131.dst: Essa era a última? Vamos voltar ao Rurie e... e dizer que está feito.
Shrouded in Mist#131.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#132.src: Return to Rurie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and discuss the next step.
Shrouded in Mist#132.dst: Volte até Rurie em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] e discuta o próximo passo.

Shrouded in Mist#133.src: Well well! So the newbies return! Tell me, how did you find your trial?
Shrouded in Mist#133.dst: Ora, ora! Os novatos voltaram! Digam, o que acharam da prova?
Shrouded in Mist#133.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#134.src: We did what you asked, so... so tell us about our friends, already!
Shrouded in Mist#134.dst: Fizemos o que pediu, então... então fale logo dos nossos amigos!
Shrouded in Mist#134.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#135.src: Ah ah ah! Not so fast! I'm afraid you're not done quite yet!
Shrouded in Mist#135.dst: Ah ah ah! Não tão rápido! Receio que ainda não terminaram!
Shrouded in Mist#135.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#137.src: Deadly serious, I fear! That, dear friends, was but the first part of your task.
Shrouded in Mist#137.dst: Mortalmente sério, receio! Aquilo, caros amigos, foi só a primeira parte.
Shrouded in Mist#137.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#138.src: Oh, but on the contrary! I received word immediately once you had done the deed.
Shrouded in Mist#138.dst: Ah, pelo contrário! Recebi a notícia assim que vocês fizeram o serviço.
Shrouded in Mist#138.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#139.src: Ugh... we had an agreement! You can't just-
Shrouded in Mist#139.dst: Argh... tínhamos um acordo! Você não pode-
Shrouded in Mist#139.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#140.src: But I can. If you want our support, you'll do what we ask. If it is any consolation, this is the last I will ask of you before our deal is concluded.
Shrouded in Mist#140.dst: Mas posso. Se querem nosso apoio, farão o que pedimos. Se serve de consolo, é a última coisa que vou pedir antes de encerrarmos o acordo.
Shrouded in Mist#140.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#142.src: I would ask of you to kindly... ehm, transport an {p} citizen here. Do make sure you aren't spotted by anyone else! That could cause... issues.
Shrouded in Mist#142.dst: Eu pediria que gentilmente... hã, trouxessem um cidadão de {p} até aqui. E garantam que ninguém mais os veja! Isso poderia causar... problemas.
Shrouded in Mist#142.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#144.src: Ah! Allow me to rephrase. You need to kidnap them.
Shrouded in Mist#144.dst: Ah! Deixem-me reformular. Vocês precisam sequestrá-lo.
Shrouded in Mist#144.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#146.src: Yes, indeed! Kidnap them, bring them here, and we will deal with the rest.
Shrouded in Mist#146.dst: Isso mesmo! Sequestrem, tragam aqui, e do resto cuidamos nós.
Shrouded in Mist#146.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#147.src: You want us to just... just snatch a random citizen from their home? And, and what do you mean "deal with the rest?"
Shrouded in Mist#147.dst: Quer que a gente... arranque um cidadão qualquer de casa? E, e o que quer dizer com "cuidamos do resto"?
Shrouded in Mist#147.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#148.src: No questions, young lady! Not if you'd like to ensure the safety of your friend, that is.
Shrouded in Mist#148.dst: Sem perguntas, mocinha! Não se quiser garantir a segurança do seu amigo, claro.
Shrouded in Mist#148.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#150.src: You didn't even tell us who we're looking for!
Shrouded in Mist#150.dst: Você nem disse quem estamos procurando!
Shrouded in Mist#150.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#151.src: Ahaha, apologies, my mistake! You'll be looking for the man named Nisen. Bring him here, but don't take too long!
Shrouded in Mist#151.dst: Ahaha, perdão, erro meu! Vocês vão procurar o homem chamado Nisen. Tragam-no aqui, mas não demorem!
Shrouded in Mist#151.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#152.src: Nisen. Fine. {u}, let's... talk about this outside the cave.
Shrouded in Mist#152.dst: Nisen. Tá. {u}, vamos... falar disso fora da caverna.
Shrouded in Mist#152.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#153.src: Leave the cave and discuss the plan with Sui at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#153.dst: Saia da caverna e discuta o plano com Sui em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#155.src: This... this is just getting ridiculous.
Shrouded in Mist#155.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#156.src: We, we need to find a way to get Yusanu back, and... and get out of here.
Shrouded in Mist#156.dst: A gente, a gente tem que achar como resgatar o Yusanu e... e sair daqui.
Shrouded in Mist#156.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#157.src: I know, I know, I know! And if we start looking, they'll, they'll notice.
Shrouded in Mist#157.dst: Eu sei, eu sei, eu sei! E se começarmos a procurar, eles, eles vão notar.
Shrouded in Mist#157.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#158.src: I'm... sick and tired of following that clown's orders. But you're right...
Shrouded in Mist#158.dst: Estou... farta de seguir ordens daquele palhaço. Mas você tem razão...
Shrouded in Mist#158.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#159.src: It's just... weird. This last task. I don't get it.
Shrouded in Mist#159.dst: É só... estranho. Essa última tarefa. Não entendo.
Shrouded in Mist#159.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#160.src: Even if Rurie's out of his mind... I don't see him just- just killing an innocent person. Especially if they're, um, a resistance group.
Shrouded in Mist#160.dst: Mesmo que o Rurie seja doido... não o vejo simplesmente- matando um inocente. Ainda mais sendo, hã, um grupo de resistência.
Shrouded in Mist#160.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#161.src: Ugh. I don't know. Maybe if we investigate this Nisen person, we'll... figure out Rurie's reasoning.
Shrouded in Mist#161.dst: Argh. Sei lá. Talvez se investigarmos esse tal de Nisen, a gente... entenda o motivo do Rurie.
Shrouded in Mist#161.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#163.src: Head to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and locate Nisen.
Shrouded in Mist#163.dst: Vá até {p} em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] e encontre Nisen.

Shrouded in Mist#165.src: Phew. Getting up here really wasn't the easiest... the Red Fox back in Auburn really, ha, pales in comparison.
Shrouded in Mist#165.dst: Ufa. Subir aqui não foi nada fácil... a Raposa Vermelha lá em Auburn, ha, nem se compara.
Shrouded in Mist#165.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#166.src: I've been trying to get information on Nisen, but... people don't seem to like me much.
Shrouded in Mist#166.dst: Tentei conseguir informações sobre o Nisen, mas... o povo não parece gostar de mim.
Shrouded in Mist#166.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#167.src: Maybe you'll have some better luck?
Shrouded in Mist#167.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#180.src: ...I don't...see it. You haven't got one- Er. I. I mean. Nothing. No. Definitely, uh...definitely not.
Shrouded in Mist#180.dst: ...não...vejo. Você não tem um- Hã. Eu. Quer dizer. Nada. Não. Com certeza, hã...com certeza não.
Shrouded in Mist#180.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#181.src: I can't- look, I'm really not supposed to be talking to you at all, and- Wait, that counts as- urgh!
Shrouded in Mist#181.dst: Não posso- olha, nem devia estar falando com você, e- Espera, isso também conta como- argh!
Shrouded in Mist#181.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#183.src: ...I'm. I. You. ...ugh, I'm no good at this.
Shrouded in Mist#183.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#184.src: ...well. ...sorry, Nisen... I. I do know. I shouldn't be telling you, but I do know. Please don't hurt me.
Shrouded in Mist#184.dst: ...bem. ...desculpa, Nisen... eu. Eu sei, sim. Não devia te contar, mas sei. Por favor, não me machuque.
Shrouded in Mist#184.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#185.src: You need to take the zipline north-west. Not the one that goes upwards, though.
Shrouded in Mist#185.dst: Pegue a tirolesa a noroeste. Mas não a que sobe.
Shrouded in Mist#185.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#187.dst: ...para...para de me olhar tão de perto.
Shrouded in Mist#187.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#190.src: Search Nisen's house for any [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] clues regarding him.
Shrouded in Mist#190.dst: Vasculhe a casa de Nisen em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] atrás de pistas sobre ele.

Shrouded in Mist#191.src: Um, let's hope he's not home...
Shrouded in Mist#191.dst: Tomara que ele não esteja em casa...
Shrouded in Mist#191.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#192.src: That's odd... the latest entry's dated from weeks ago.
Shrouded in Mist#192.dst: Que estranho... o último registro é de semanas atrás.
Shrouded in Mist#192.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#193.src: It's like they stopped writing them abruptly...
Shrouded in Mist#193.dst: Parece que ele parou de escrever de repente...
Shrouded in Mist#193.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#194.dst: Saia rápido da casa de Nisen em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#196.src: Eep! That must be Nisen! We need to think of an excuse...
Shrouded in Mist#196.dst: Ai! Deve ser o Nisen! Temos que inventar uma desculpa...
Shrouded in Mist#196.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#197.src: Excuse me? What are you doing in my abode?
Shrouded in Mist#197.dst: Com licença? O que fazem na minha morada?
Shrouded in Mist#197.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#198.src: If I am not mistaken, stumbling into other people's abodes is not a custom.
Shrouded in Mist#198.dst: Se não me engano, entrar na morada alheia sem querer não é costume.
Shrouded in Mist#198.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#199.src: Oh... I- I'm so sorry! I- I- we- we thought this was the... bakery.
Shrouded in Mist#199.dst: Ah... d- desculpa! A- a gente- a gente achou que era a... padaria.
Shrouded in Mist#199.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#201.src: Oh. Yes, wrong building. The bakery is down at ground level.
Shrouded in Mist#201.dst: Ah. Sim, prédio errado. A padaria fica embaixo, no térreo.
Shrouded in Mist#201.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#202.src: Oh! Thank you for the directions. We are... so sorry for the misunderstanding.
Shrouded in Mist#202.dst: Ah! Obrigada pela ajuda. Sentimos... muito pelo engano.
Shrouded in Mist#202.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#203.src: Regroup with Sui at the main square at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#203.dst: Reencontre Sui na praça principal em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#205.src: That was close... I'm, um, surprised he believed us.
Shrouded in Mist#205.dst: Foi por pouco... Fiquei, hã, surpresa que ele acreditou.
Shrouded in Mist#205.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#207.src: I- I panicked, okay! But it worked, didn't it?
Shrouded in Mist#207.dst: E- entrei em pânico, tá! Mas funcionou, né?
Shrouded in Mist#207.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#208.src: He was... surprisingly chatty. That's a nice change compared to everyone else.
Shrouded in Mist#208.dst: Ele foi... bem falante. Uma boa mudança comparado com os outros.
Shrouded in Mist#208.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#209.src: Though, um, he was a bit... odd. He didn't seem too certain about his answers...
Shrouded in Mist#209.dst: Mas, hã, ele era meio... esquisito. Não parecia muito seguro das respostas...
Shrouded in Mist#209.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#210.src: I don't know. What are you thinking? Any theories?
Shrouded in Mist#210.dst: Não sei. O que você acha? Alguma teoria?
Shrouded in Mist#210.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#212.src: I... was thinking the same thing. It'd explain the diary entries stopping abruptly...
Shrouded in Mist#212.dst: Eu... pensei o mesmo. Explicaria o diário parar de repente...
Shrouded in Mist#212.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#214.src: Maybe... I guess he could be. I might just be jumping to conclusions.
Shrouded in Mist#214.dst: Talvez... acho que pode ser. Talvez eu esteja tirando conclusões.
Shrouded in Mist#214.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#215.src: Uh... let's workshop that one a little.
Shrouded in Mist#215.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#216.src: Look, I managed to snag a schedule off his bedside table.
Shrouded in Mist#216.dst: Olha, consegui pegar uma agenda da mesa de cabeceira dele.
Shrouded in Mist#216.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#217.src: Listen to this. "Deliver hunting tools from weaponsmith through southern exit at noon."
Shrouded in Mist#217.dst: Escuta só. "Entregar ferramentas de caça do armeiro pela saída sul ao meio-dia."
Shrouded in Mist#217.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#218.src: It's weird, right? Something's definitely off with him... but still, kidnapping him and handing him off to some... some random bird-man! I don't like it.
Shrouded in Mist#218.dst: Estranho, né? Tem algo errado com ele... mas, mesmo assim, sequestrá-lo e entregar a um... um homem-pássaro qualquer! Não gosto disso.
Shrouded in Mist#218.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#219.src: But... we don't have much of a choice. Let's camp out outside the southern gate and wait...
Shrouded in Mist#219.dst: Mas... não temos muita escolha. Vamos acampar perto do portão sul e esperar...
Shrouded in Mist#219.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#222.src: Guess we'll just have to wait...
Shrouded in Mist#222.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#223.src: I... ha, I've been feeling really out of my depth, here. I've never had to do this much without... um, without their support.
Shrouded in Mist#223.dst: Eu... ha, ando me sentindo bem perdida aqui. Nunca tive que fazer tanto sem... hã, sem o apoio deles.
Shrouded in Mist#223.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#224.src: But... you're here to help, so. Um. Thanks for- for sticking with me. I... I don't think I'd have made it this far without you.
Shrouded in Mist#224.dst: Mas... você está aqui ajudando, então. Hã. Obrigada por- por ficar comigo. Eu... acho que sem você não teria chegado até aqui.
Shrouded in Mist#224.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#227.src: Um... I think it worked, though. Can you help me?
Shrouded in Mist#227.dst: Hã... mas acho que funcionou. Pode me ajudar?
Shrouded in Mist#227.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#228.src: That was... easier than I expected it to be.
Shrouded in Mist#228.dst: Isso foi... mais fácil do que eu esperava.
Shrouded in Mist#228.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#229.src: I kind of just, um, landed on top of him? And... and here we are.
Shrouded in Mist#229.dst: Eu meio que, hã, caí em cima dele? E... e aqui estamos.
Shrouded in Mist#229.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#230.src: We should... probably get moving. I don't want anyone to- to see us!
Shrouded in Mist#230.dst: A gente devia... ir logo. Não quero que ninguém- ninguém nos veja!
Shrouded in Mist#230.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#231.src: Um! Control is... maybe not the right word. I... ha, I tried to freeze him. So... still working on it. I guess.
Shrouded in Mist#231.dst: Hã! Controle talvez... não seja a palavra. Eu... ha, tentei congelá-lo. Então... ainda estou treinando. Acho.
Shrouded in Mist#231.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#232.src: ......how are we going to move him?
Shrouded in Mist#232.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#233.src: So, how do we carry him?

Shrouded in Mist#234.src: Um! I... didn't think about that.
Shrouded in Mist#234.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#235.src: Well well, newbies! Looks like you could use a hand!
Shrouded in Mist#235.dst: Ora, ora, novatos! Parece que precisam de uma mãozinha!
Shrouded in Mist#235.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#236.src: Aah! Wh- where did you come from?!
Shrouded in Mist#236.dst: Aah! D- de onde você veio?!
Shrouded in Mist#236.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#237.src: Why, from the trees, of course! I see you've managed to subdue the good mister Nisen over here, well done, well done.
Shrouded in Mist#237.dst: Ora, das árvores, claro! Vejo que conseguiram dominar o bom senhor Nisen aqui, muito bem, muito bem.
Shrouded in Mist#237.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#238.src: ...we've done everything you've asked for. Now- now tell us what you know!!
Shrouded in Mist#238.dst: ...fizemos tudo o que você pediu. Agora- agora diga o que sabe!!
Shrouded in Mist#238.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#239.src: Oh, dear, you thought you two were done? Ha! Ahahaha!
Shrouded in Mist#239.dst: Ah, querida, acharam que tinham terminado? Ha! Ahahaha!
Shrouded in Mist#239.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#241.src: Kidding! Kidding, kidding- goodness, the looks on your faces! What's a little practical joke between friends, eh?
Shrouded in Mist#241.dst: Brincadeira! Brincadeira, brincadeira- nossa, que caras! O que é uma pegadinha entre amigos, hein?
Shrouded in Mist#241.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#242.src: Fine! Fine, fine, I get it! Jeez, lady...
Shrouded in Mist#242.dst: Tá! Tá, tá, entendi! Credo, moça...
Shrouded in Mist#242.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#243.src: I'll cut it with the jokes... for now. Good news! You've passed the test!
Shrouded in Mist#243.dst: Vou parar com as piadas... por ora. Boa notícia! Vocês passaram no teste!
Shrouded in Mist#243.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#245.src: Yes, yes, settle down, I will tell you. Give me a moment! Goodness. You're an impatient one, aren't you?
Shrouded in Mist#245.dst: Sim, sim, calma, eu vou contar. Me deem um momento! Nossa. Você é bem impaciente, hein?
Shrouded in Mist#245.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#246.src: I'll be bringing you two to the Canopy! But, ah, one little precaution- I'll have to blindfold you till we arrive. Just a security measure!
Shrouded in Mist#246.dst: Vou levar vocês dois ao Dosel! Mas, ah, uma pequena precaução- vou ter que vendar vocês até chegarmos. Só por segurança!
Shrouded in Mist#246.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#247.src: Ugh... you know what, I don't even care anymore. Just... bring us to Yusanu.
Shrouded in Mist#247.dst: Argh... quer saber, nem ligo mais. Só... leve a gente até o Yusanu.
Shrouded in Mist#247.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#249.src: Ugh! Fine fine fine! But hurry up.
Shrouded in Mist#249.dst: Argh! Tá, tá, tá! Mas anda logo.
Shrouded in Mist#249.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#250.src: Rurie, care to explain yourself? Why did you bring these outsiders here?
Shrouded in Mist#250.dst: Rurie, pode se explicar? Por que trouxe esses forasteiros aqui?
Shrouded in Mist#250.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#252.src: Ah, you know how it is, Fuhue! I was oh so bored on patrol this morning! You lot aren't exactly the life of the party..
Shrouded in Mist#252.dst: Ah, você sabe como é, Fuhue! A patrulha de hoje cedo foi um tédio! Vocês não são lá a alegria da festa..
Shrouded in Mist#252.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#253.src: You know Azael has clear rules on recruiting. Did you file the necessary paperwork? Because I didn't see anything on my desk regarding this.
Shrouded in Mist#253.dst: Sabe que Azael tem regras claras sobre recrutamento. Preencheu a papelada? Porque não vi nada sobre isso na minha mesa.
Shrouded in Mist#253.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#254.src: The... ah, the paperwork was real? I always thought it was something you were making up for the fun of it.
Shrouded in Mist#254.dst: A... ah, a papelada era de verdade? Sempre achei que você inventava por diversão.
Shrouded in Mist#254.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#255.src: No. We have the protocols in place for a reason, Captain Rurie. Will you find the time to review them yourself, or must I have Captain Cileon run you through them?
Shrouded in Mist#255.dst: Não. Os protocolos existem por um motivo, capitão Rurie. Vai arranjar tempo pra revisá-los, ou terei que pedir ao capitão Cileon que os explique?
Shrouded in Mist#255.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#256.src: Yes, yes, I understand the importance- though, I believe Cileon shares my views on the protocols. Isn't that right, Cileon?
Shrouded in Mist#256.dst: Sim, sim, entendo a importância- mas creio que Cileon partilha da minha visão sobre os protocolos. Não é, Cileon?
Shrouded in Mist#256.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#258.src: H- hey! Don't just act like, like we aren't right here!
Shrouded in Mist#258.dst: E- ei! Não ajam como, como se a gente não estivesse aqui!
Shrouded in Mist#258.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#259.src: Cileon! That is also against our protocols. We wouldn't want to leave a body for the crown to find, we have far simpler forms of disposal.
Shrouded in Mist#259.dst: Cileon! Isso também é contra os protocolos. Não queremos deixar um corpo pra Coroa achar, temos formas bem mais simples de descarte.
Shrouded in Mist#259.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#260.src: And of course, we need to torture any necessary information out of them first - I have heard this a dozen times over.
Shrouded in Mist#260.dst: E claro, primeiro temos que arrancar sob tortura as informações necessárias - já ouvi isso uma dúzia de vezes.
Shrouded in Mist#260.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#261.src: Ah! You were listening! Good, Captain Rurie. We'll knock some sense into you yet.
Shrouded in Mist#261.dst: Ah! Você estava ouvindo! Muito bem, capitão Rurie. Ainda vamos pôr juízo em você.
Shrouded in Mist#261.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#262.src: I did have some deerlings bring Nisen into our processing room earlier. Thank you for your service, Captain.
Shrouded in Mist#262.dst: Já mandei uns cervinhos levarem o Nisen à sala de triagem. Obrigada pelo serviço, capitão.
Shrouded in Mist#262.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#263.src: Ah, no problem! Hardly even broke a sweat!
Shrouded in Mist#263.dst: Ah, não foi nada! Nem suei!
Shrouded in Mist#263.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#264.src: Well, I'll be catching up with you later! I suppose if we're following protocols, I'll need to hand these kids off to Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#264.dst: Bem, a gente se vê depois! Se vamos seguir os protocolos, acho que terei de entregar essas crianças ao Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#264.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#265.src: Hey hey, friends! I'm a bit thirsty, so I'll be leaving you now! Think you'll manage to find Azael yourselves?
Shrouded in Mist#265.dst: Ei, ei, amigos! Estou com sede, então vou deixá-los aqui! Acham que conseguem achar o Azael sozinhos?
Shrouded in Mist#265.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#266.src: Find the leader inside the Canopy at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shrouded in Mist#266.dst: Encontre o líder dentro do Dosel em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#267.src: Hm. Rurie told you to find Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#267.speaker: Cileon

Shrouded in Mist#275.src: The schedule's always so busy... and now I have even more to deal with.
Shrouded in Mist#275.dst: A agenda sempre lotada... e agora tenho ainda mais com que lidar.
Shrouded in Mist#275.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#276.src: But I suppose I can squeeze you in for questions.
Shrouded in Mist#276.dst: Mas acho que consigo um tempinho pras perguntas.
Shrouded in Mist#276.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#277.src: I am Fuhue, Team Captain of the Deer clan.
Shrouded in Mist#277.dst: Sou Fuhue, capitã do clã dos Cervos.
Shrouded in Mist#277.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#278.src: I also function as the overall manager of the Canopy, not just the Deer operations.
Shrouded in Mist#278.dst: Também atuo como gerente geral do Dosel, não só das operações dos Cervos.
Shrouded in Mist#278.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#279.src: Master Azael can be found in his hut... it's just to the south-west of here.
Shrouded in Mist#279.dst: O mestre Azael está na cabana dele... fica logo a sudoeste daqui.
Shrouded in Mist#279.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#280.src: From what I've heard, your friend is over there as well.
Shrouded in Mist#280.dst: Pelo que ouvi, seu amigo também está lá.
Shrouded in Mist#280.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#281.src: I'm afraid so. Insufferable as always...
Shrouded in Mist#281.dst: Receio que sim. Insuportável como sempre...
Shrouded in Mist#281.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#282.src: But he's incredibly talented at what he does. No one else could run the Owls like he does.
Shrouded in Mist#282.dst: Mas é de um talento incrível no que faz. Ninguém comandaria as Corujas como ele.
Shrouded in Mist#282.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#284.src: Or not! It's Master Azael's decision as to whether you stay or not. Just hope you manage to impress him.
Shrouded in Mist#284.dst: Ou não! Cabe ao mestre Azael decidir se vocês ficam. Tomara que o impressionem.
Shrouded in Mist#284.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#285.src: I have heard about your adventures in the {p} thus far. Very impressive work.
Shrouded in Mist#285.dst: Ouvi falar das suas aventuras em {p} até agora. Um trabalho muito notável.
Shrouded in Mist#285.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#286.src: Not to interrupt you, but we've been running around all day, and I'm tired. Where's Yusanu?
Shrouded in Mist#286.dst: Não quero interromper, mas corremos o dia todo e estou cansada. Cadê o Yusanu?
Shrouded in Mist#286.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#289.src: Oh, you're okay... I'm so glad.
Shrouded in Mist#289.dst: Ah, você está bem... que alívio.
Shrouded in Mist#289.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#290.src: Yes, reunited at last. But now that you are here, it is time for business.
Shrouded in Mist#290.dst: Sim, enfim reunidos. Mas agora que estão aqui, vamos aos negócios.
Shrouded in Mist#290.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#291.src: I had Yusanu inform me of your adventures in the {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#291.dst: Pedi ao Yusanu que me contasse suas aventuras em {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#291.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#292.src: And it would appear our causes are in alignment... to dismantle the crown. We here in the Canopy have taken a very active approach to this end.
Shrouded in Mist#292.dst: E parece que nossas causas se alinham... derrubar a Coroa. Nós, do Dosel, adotamos uma postura bem ativa nesse sentido.
Shrouded in Mist#292.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#293.src: We had established three teams, each with their own responsibility. Each team attacks the crown on different fronts.
Shrouded in Mist#293.dst: Formamos três equipes, cada uma com sua função. Cada equipe ataca a Coroa numa frente diferente.
Shrouded in Mist#293.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#294.src: The Owls are our eyes and ears. They are also our most efficient assassins. Captain Rurie, who you have already had the pleasure of meeting, is one of our most lethal members.
Shrouded in Mist#294.dst: As Corujas são nossos olhos e ouvidos. Também são nossos assassinos mais eficazes. O capitão Rurie, que já tiveram o prazer de conhecer, é um dos mais letais.
Shrouded in Mist#294.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#295.src: The Foxes are our assault team. They are skilled swordsmen utilizing techniques native to the {p}. They are trained to never lose a duel.
Shrouded in Mist#295.dst: As Raposas são nossa equipe de assalto. São espadachins hábeis que usam técnicas nativas de {p}. Treinados para nunca perder um duelo.
Shrouded in Mist#295.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#296.src: The Deers are our command team, the brains behind the operation. They are also responsible for... taking care of spies within {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#296.dst: Os Cervos são nossa equipe de comando, o cérebro da operação. Também cuidam de... dar conta dos espiões dentro de {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#296.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#298.src: Spies. That man you brought in, Nisen... I fear that is no longer Nisen. Weeks ago, he had been replaced by one of the crown's elite spies. We know them as Changelings.
Shrouded in Mist#298.dst: Espiões. O homem que trouxeram, Nisen... receio que já não seja o Nisen. Há semanas, foi trocado por um dos espiões de elite da Coroa. Os chamamos de metamorfos.
Shrouded in Mist#298.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#299.src: The {p} have been plagued for years by these masterful creatures of disguise. Whenever one is recognized, we capture them and hold them for questioning.
Shrouded in Mist#299.dst: {p} sofre há anos com essas mestras do disfarce. Sempre que reconhecemos uma, nós a capturamos e retemos para interrogatório.
Shrouded in Mist#299.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#300.src: The people of our region have developed a form of identification, the medallions. If you do not possess one, many will refuse to speak with you.
Shrouded in Mist#300.dst: O povo da região criou uma forma de identificação, os medalhões. Se não tiverem um, muitos se recusarão a falar com vocês.
Shrouded in Mist#300.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#301.src: Um... Azael, sir, I don't mean to come off as rude, but... Rurie told us there were news on our friends from the Roughworks.
Shrouded in Mist#301.dst: Hã... senhor Azael, não quero ser grosseira, mas... Rurie disse que havia notícias dos nossos amigos de Roughworks.
Shrouded in Mist#301.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#302.src: In a sense, there are. However, we still are processing the information the Owls have returned with from the festival. I cannot offer anything just yet.
Shrouded in Mist#302.dst: De certa forma, há. Mas ainda estamos processando o que as Corujas trouxeram do festival. Não posso oferecer nada ainda.
Shrouded in Mist#302.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#303.src: Rest assured, we will not withhold anything once we have gone through everything.
Shrouded in Mist#303.dst: Fiquem tranquilos, não esconderemos nada depois de revisarmos tudo.
Shrouded in Mist#303.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#304.src: I give you my word that we will continue searching for any word of your friends.
Shrouded in Mist#304.dst: Dou minha palavra de que seguiremos buscando notícias dos seus amigos.
Shrouded in Mist#304.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#305.src: It... it finally feels like we have a second to breathe.
Shrouded in Mist#305.dst: Enfim... enfim parece que temos um tempo pra respirar.
Shrouded in Mist#305.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#306.src: I'll stay with Yusanu and wait for them to sort through the information.
Shrouded in Mist#306.dst: Vou ficar com o Yusanu e esperar que analisem as informações.
Shrouded in Mist#306.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#307.src: I'm going to focus on figuring out what this device is used for.
Shrouded in Mist#307.dst: Vou me concentrar em descobrir pra que serve este aparelho.
Shrouded in Mist#307.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#308.src: It must have been worth stealing it... somehow.
Shrouded in Mist#308.dst: Deve ter valido a pena roubá-lo... de algum jeito.
Shrouded in Mist#308.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#309.src: It looks like someone's diary. The latest entries are dated {~} IA.
Shrouded in Mist#309.dst: Parece o diário de alguém. Os últimos registros são de {~} IA.

Shrouded in Mist#310.src: - Entry {~}: Mother came by today. She is taking their separation quite poorly.
Shrouded in Mist#310.dst: - Registro {~}: Mãe veio hoje. Ela está levando a separação bem mal.

Shrouded in Mist#311.src: - Entry {~}: Father tried to bring me fresh produce today. I asked him about mother, and he left.
Shrouded in Mist#311.dst: - Registro {~}: Pai tentou me trazer verduras frescas hoje. Perguntei da mãe, e ele foi embora.

Shrouded in Mist#312.src: - Entry {~}: I stopped talking to Father. Mother came by my work at the market. We went for food after.
Shrouded in Mist#312.dst: - Registro {~}: Parei de falar com o pai. Mãe foi me ver no trabalho no mercado. Depois fomos comer.

Shrouded in Mist#313.src: There's a note with information slipped between the pages: Parents divorced. Working at market.
Shrouded in Mist#313.dst: Há um bilhete com informações entre as páginas: Pais divorciados. Trabalha no mercado.

Shrouded in Mist#314.src: Seems like no one has slept here in a while.
Shrouded in Mist#314.dst: Parece que ninguém dorme aqui há um tempo.

Shrouded in Mist#315.src: - Entry {~}: I had a normal day today. Helped my friend carry some food to their house.
Shrouded in Mist#315.dst: - Registro {~}: Hoje foi um dia normal. Ajudei um amigo a levar comida pra casa dele.

Shrouded in Mist#316.src: Find a way to destroy the drill, fast.
Shrouded in Mist#316.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#318.src: The sweeper did no damage to the monitor...
Shrouded in Mist#318.dst: A varredeira não causou dano ao monitor...
